review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for this frozen case. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, exact writable owner scopes, evidence stages, and task identities agree with the original PRD. The source supports a derived read-only getter without another counter or scheduling changes; the acceptance criteria correctly preserve completed/error event timing and defer final-zero assertions until onIdle. The build configuration supports treating dist declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners. The supplied nz runner discovers test-d files, performs compiler-only checking, and supports negative type assertions despite the repository tsconfig including only source. TASK-VERIFY remains independent and depends on TASK-IMPLEMENT; both tasks must cover every required acceptance criterion. The allowed agents have the relevant active trusted capability claims, including data.change and integration.consumer, with testing.verification additionally present for the verifier. The selected planning reviewer is consistent with the supplied selection policy. No material unresolved Decision is supplied for this case, so ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate; this does not authorize dispatch or execution. Repository, source, team, decision, model, budget, and policy fingerprints are consistent across the supplied freeze, with manifest and evaluation source digests explicitly using different domains. The original specification's remaining preparation items describe its earlier preparation state, not an additional planning blocker. Review was based solely on the supplied pre-candidate evidence and Service-bound fingerprints; I did not execute code, recompute digests, or create human attestations.
